mixins.description:
Type names of all Types that are mixed into this Type either explicitly or implicitly
through other mixins, ordered from closest to farthest mixin.

title:
A lighter version of {@link TypeMetaDeps} that only includes relevant information for
comparing {@link App} [versions](SemanticVersion).

{@link TypeMetaDeps} cannot be used directly for comparing versions because most of its
fields directly reference {@link Type}s. When comparing two versions, the complete Type
system might not be available for each version, so any Types that no longer exist in a
given version but are referenced by {@link TypeMetaDeps} would cause invalid reference
errors when trying to construct the object.

@see BaseCodeAnalysis.TypeInfo
name: BaseCodeAnalysis.TypeMetaDeps
